title: My dream world
content: Thought this was kind of fun so thought I'd share my dream world, too! I do have a dream world which I am in the vast majority of my dreams. There is a mall I'd say center of the areas I frequent and a large portion of my dreams start there. The mall is very big. It does look futuristic. There is a 2 story food court with elevators and escalaters. Theres also a red staircase that swoops down in an oddly circular shape. Somewhere in that food court is a decent restraunt and a cool arcade. Lots of toys to be won that people carry around. Ive wandered the shops before, looking at things, often clothes stores. Theres even a grocery section. There was a period of time where I frequently thought in my awake time of the arcade within my dream throughout the day. At one point i noticed a few aquantences staring at a big fish tank at the mall. I went to stare too. It was hypnotising. In this dream, we were pulled through into another world. At first, we were traveling through hallways, going room to room looking over our shoulder to try and get out of a a large factory like building. Then, we went through a door and were outside. There was a feeling of being at war and the feeling of needing to flee/hide from something that could be attacking from above. I remember constantly trying to run to cover after a building seemed to be attacked but also knowing that nothing was actually good cover. There was no plan to attack back or escape. Just, hopefully, survive. I spent my awake days thinking about the war like world often. The world this mall is in is very big. There is a train and a more futuristic airplane like shuttle system. The train heads west through a wooded area. I am often walking through the forest, knowing where I am going or just spending time there. I know the wooded area well and there it is always dusk. I recall being at a certain spot, looking across a river over towards a big forested hill on the other side and understanding where I am in relation to where I am going. This is another moment I frequently think about in my awake days. Through the forest is a school and neighborhoods and it is always night. Ive not been in the school. The houses are very scary to me. Often I'll start my dream in one. Or I'll be walking through the neighborhood and feel compelled against my better judgement to enter. The houses feel huge once I am in them, easily I can get lost or disoriented. Each door leads to a different persona or emotion. Rather quickly, I'll want to leave but I don't think I have ever successfully done so in any dream. Sometimes I run into dead relatives or strangers. Often listening to their anger or sadness and trying to find an exit from the room and.... conversations? I'm not even sure if words are actually said outloud there. But communication is had. Anywho, the train stops past the neighborhoods up on a hill. Where it stops it is day time. My earliest memory with this dream world was my grandma, who is deceased. I met her at this train stop in this world and she explained it was a place for us to meet and be. At the time i was ecstatic to have received this world and from the train stop it appears like a lovely world. Since then my default dreaming is there. She died when I was 14 and I am 30 now so have had lots of years here. I meet her there at the stop occasionally for a day of bonding. We often take the shuttle plane thing. The shuttle plane thing is where the fun begins for me. It's a bit snug once inside but dream me feels it quite the experience. It will go to where the ocean is located to the east. It first stops in a big city with lots of offices, restraunts, shops etc. Lots of fun things to do like a big city and t's fairly easy for me to navigate. A bit beyond that is a beach near the ocean. A big tourist spot, lots or people. There are hotels and a recreational part for the beach with a walkway. I stayed with my grandma at one of the hotels once and we had a fun day at the beach! Near the beach is some sort of power plant, I assume, that seems to harnesses the energy of the waves. It is pretty cool to watch the waves come crashing onto this big metallic structure. In the city there is a library. At the back of the library is a door that leads to a cozier dark area which is lit with a crackling fireplace. There are couches and chairs as well as bookcases. I often sleep or rest on a particular couch that conveniently has a throw blanket and pillow. Often that's how I wake up, by falling asleep. It seems to be my "home" spot within the dream world. Anywho, one time I fell asleep on the couch and woke up in another library but obviously asian and from hundreds of years ago, I assume. I got the sense I needed to hurry to find a key and get into a door that was on the back left side of the library. The feeling was as if I didn't hurry then the library or my ability to access it could be destroyed before i can enter. I knew where the key was so it wasn't that hard to locate and proceed to open the door. But when I stepped through the door I was in another world. There was someone waiting for me. Ive seen him before but don't recall where. Anyway, he was silent and we walked through this like, lifeless, almost desert, yet cold dirt land until we came upon a couple book shelves. One held books from the past and one from the future. The guy told me in my mind that I could take 3 books. I didn't think much on it, it was like the thought came to me to grab a certain book and I knew what it was instantly. I grabbed 3 books from the past. One was a book that I knew represented the guy. He seemed important. One was something that I knew would give me the ability to return to this area, if I needed in the future. The third was to go back to a particular past life. Once that was chosen I was in yet another world. In this world, I was laying down on a floor though I could sit up some some. I was in a seemingly older Asian house somewhere in Asia. I was a man (irl i am a woman) I had a wound to my abdomen that I knew I was dying of. Idr how I got it, but i remember knowing there were others like me, outside somewhere, where i felt i should have been. I remember where I was laying I could see out side. I remember admiring the beauty of it but also never wanting to see it again. There was a female attending to my wounds at times and other times I could hear her walking or doing other things. I got the sense that it was this great favor to have been brought in the house to die, but like it was obvious I was going to die and I felt it odd that i had been granted these final moments of comfort. I appreciated the comfort but also felt like what a waste it was to invest energy into me. I remember appreciating the smells, sounds, visuals but also just never wanting to have anything to do with that existence ever again. I was ready to be far from that world. I didn't feel pain, though I knew I was in it and I knew I couldn't get all the way up. Eventually I died, i assume, and I woke up. That was my latest weirdly memorable one. I think it must all stem from my life/experiences. Like, I did once work at a mall though there was no arcade and I never dream of working at it. My grandma's house did have a train that would go passed it. My experiences getting on a plane means I'm going to have fun. The library is kinda weird. As a kid my grandma took me to the library on occasion, but I didn't spend much time in one nor do I read a lot of books irl. I also don't have a habit of sleeping on couches or being near a fire place so unsure why that's my home. I do like Asian things. I often view like, travel shows on youtube and the sceneries in nature or just the way the architecture is, feels nostalgic. Like I'm familiar with it and i appreciate the beauty though ive never seen the images im seeing in some random town. I'm not like a huge anime fan. I've seen some in my youth but im not like obsessed with anime or like k pop/ asian dramas etc. I just kinda like Asia in general similarly to how someone might have an appreciation for the beauty and architecture in Europe, i imagine. I do like video games, particularly medieval Europe ones so perhaps the past life thing stems from that, in combination lol Perhaps the houses is where I deal with my own emotions but it's easier to project as if other people. The forest might just be a calming place. The food court, shopping, and arcade seem like casual fun places to be in. Irl I do like to window shop. The war thing idk perhaps at the time I was working through anxieties. It is weird tho that some of us have these dream worlds and they seem to often include this big futuristic mall lol I wonder if there is psychology behind it.
